topic: Kotlin Benchmark for AI Coding Agents: How Well Do AI Agents Write Kotlin Compared to Python and TypeScript?

key_points: JetBrains released the official Kotlin Benchmark for AI coding agents in July 2026
Based on SWE-bench methodology, 105 engineering tasks from active open-source Kotlin repositories
Top result: Claude Code + Opus 4.7 xhigh at 85.71% resolution rate (90/105 tasks)
Junie + Opus 4.7 max and Codex + GPT 5.5 xhigh tied at 81.9%
Built on open-source Multi-SWE-bench infrastructure
Plans to expand to Android, Kotlin Multiplatform, cost/quality metrics, and more agents
SWE-bench Multilingual: 300 tasks across 42 repos and 9 languages (C, C++, Go, Java, JS, TS, PHP, Ruby, Rust)
Claude 3.7 Sonnet + SWE-agent achieves 43% resolution rate on Multilingual vs 63% on SWE-bench Verified (Python-only)
Rust had highest resolution rate, C/C++ the lowest among the 9 languages
Python significantly outperforms other languages in AI agent code generation benchmarks
Dataset available on HuggingFace, integrated into SWE-bench evaluation framework
SWE-bench Verified: 500 human-filtered Python instances, the standard for AI coding agent evaluation
SWE-bench Lite: 300 curated instances for cheaper evaluation
SWE-bench Multimodal: 517 instances with visual elements
mini-SWE-agent scores 65% on SWE-bench Verified in 100 lines of Python (July 2025)
SWE-bench Family now includes multilingual, multimodal, and verified subsets
Official Kotlin Benchmark leaderboard hosted on kotlinlang.org
19 agent+model configurations evaluated as of latest run
Top 3: Claude Code+Opus 4.7 (85.71%), Junie+Opus 4.7 (81.9%), Codex+GPT 5.5 (81.9%)
Gemini CLI + Gemini 3 Flash lowest at 44.76%
Cost per task varies from $5.31 (Claude Code Opus 4.7 medium) to $40.17 (Junie + Gemini 3 Flash)
Evaluation dates range from March to May 2026
Independent SWE-bench Verified leaderboard comparing self-reported vs verified scores
Tracks agent+model configurations with independent verification
Highlights discrepancy between vendor claims and independently verified results

stats.fact: JetBrains Kotlin Benchmark features 105 engineering tasks from active open-source Kotlin repositories
Top result: Claude Code + Opus 4.7 xhigh resolves 90/105 tasks (85.71%)
Junie + Opus 4.7 max and Codex + GPT 5.5 xhigh tied at 81.9% resolution rate
SWE-bench Multilingual: 300 tasks across 9 languages, Claude 3.7 Sonnet achieves 43% overall
Claude 3.7 Sonnet scores 63% on SWE-bench Verified (Python-only) vs 43% on Multilingual
SWE-bench Verified contains 500 human-filtered Python instances as the standard benchmark
mini-SWE-agent achieves 65% on SWE-bench Verified in just 100 lines of Python code
Kotlin Benchmark built on open-source Multi-SWE-bench infrastructure with public datasets and test harnesses
Cheapest Kotlin Benchmark run: Claude Code + Opus 4.7 medium at $5.31 per task
Most expensive Kotlin Benchmark run: Junie + Gemini 3 Flash at $40.17 per task

angles: Kotlin is catching up to Python in AI agent coding benchmarks — JetBrains' new benchmark provides the first standardized comparison
Python still leads in AI agent performance (63% SWE-bench Verified) but Kotlin is competitive (85.71% top score on Kotlin-specific tasks)
Language-specific benchmarks reveal that AI agents perform differently across languages — Kotlin now has its own dedicated evaluation framework
The gap between Python and other languages in AI code generation is narrowing with dedicated benchmarks like Kotlin Benchmark and SWE-bench Multilingual
JetBrains' open approach (Multi-SWE-bench infrastructure, public leaderboard) sets a precedent for language-specific AI coding benchmarks
TypeScript/JavaScript performance on SWE-bench Multilingual provides a useful comparison point for Kotlin's debut
